newsitem.title: USA: Neurogen stake held by BVF Inc.
newsitem.headline: Neurogen stake held by BVF Inc.

text.p: A group led by BVF Inc, an investment adviser, said Tuesday it holds a 5.8 percent stake in Neurogen Corp or 831,006 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 177,500 common shares bought between January 15 and March 5 at prices ranging from $17.0150 to $22.1370 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
Neurogen, based in Branford, Ct., discovers, develops, manufactures and markets products for treatment of neurological disorders.
